sentences.text: Hello and welcome to the Slow English podcast. My name is Emili. I'm happy you are here. Today,
we will talk about Malaysia. Malaysia is a warm, diverse and exciting country in Southeast Asia.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English. Are you ready? Let's begin. Where is Malaysia?
Malaysia is in Southeast Asia. It has two main parts, peninsula Malaysia, connected to Thailand.
East Malaysia on the island of Borneo, next to Indonesia and Brunei. Malaysia has jungles,
cities and beaches. What is the capital city of Malaysia? The capital city is Kuala Lumpur.
Kuala Lumpur is a modern city with tall buildings, shopping malls and street food.
It is also famous for the Petronas Towers. Other cities include Georgetown on Penang Island,
Johor Vahru near Singapore, Kodakinabalu in East Malaysia, Malacca, a historic city with old buildings.
How many people live in Malaysia? About 33 million people live in Malaysia.
It is a country with many cultures and languages. There are three main ethnic groups,
Malay Chinese Indian. Many people also belong to indigenous native groups, especially in Borneo.
What language do people speak in Malaysia? The official language is Malay Bahasa, Malaysia.
Many people also speak English. Chinese languages like Mandarin or Cantonese,
Tamil and Indian language. Local languages in Borneo, like Iban or Katazan. What is the weather
like in Malaysia? Malaysia has a tropical climate. It is hot and humid all year.
There are two main seasons, dry season, good for travel and beaches, rainy season with short heavy
rain. The weather is great for rainforests and fruit trees. What does Malaysia look like?
Malaysia has rainforests and jungles, tall mountains like Mount Kinnabalu, beaches and islands,
modern cities and small villages. It is rich in natural beauty and modern life.
What animals live in Malaysia? Malaysia is home to many wild animals, orangutans in Borneo,
elephants, tigers and sun bears, monkeys, lizards and hornbills, birds,
in the sea, turtles, coral and colorful fish. Malaysia has many national parks to protect animals.
What do people eat in Malaysia? Malaysian food is spicy, flavorful and multicultural.
Popular foods include nasi lemak, rice with coconut milk, eggs, peanuts and spicy sauce.
Roti Kenai, flatbread with curry, fatay, grilled meat on sticks, char koi tail, fried noodles,
laksa spicy noodle soup, tatari, sweet milk tea. People love to eat at hawker stalls and food courts.
What do people drink in Malaysia? People drink water and fruit juices? Tea, especially tatari.
Coffee often serves sweet. Soy milk and herbal drinks. In Muslim areas, alcohol is not common,
but it is available in other places. What is life like in Malaysia? Life in Malaysia is busy,
colorful and community-based. People enjoy, shopping and eating out, spending time with family,
going to the mosque, temple or church, watching movies and playing sports, celebrating many holidays.
People are friendly and different cultures live peacefully together. What are some holidays and
traditions in Malaysia? Malaysia has many public holidays. Harry Mardeka, Independence Day, August
31st. Harry Raya Edo Fittree and of Ramadan. Chinese New Year with red lanterns and lion dances.
Deepa Vali, Diwali, the Festival of Lights Christmas for Christians,
Weesak Day for Buddhists. People wear traditional clothes, cook special food and enjoy cultural
festivals. Some fun facts about Malaysia. The National Animal is the Malayan Tiger.
The Petronas Towers were once the tallest buildings in the world. Malaysia is one of the world's top
producers of rubber and palm oil. The rainforest is over 130 million years old. People often say
a lot at the end of sentences. It's a fun local style. Now you know many things about Malaysia.
